title: CAS tab wired to the CAS endpoints

features.notes: Add the cas-* elements to the CAS panel. cas-op selects one of the seven ops. app.js sends each op to its /api/cas/* endpoint, using expr or equation with var. Show result or solutions in cas-output. On a 400, show the error and replace it on the next submit. Load no external resources. Long output wraps (P33). Add a browser test like the P18 and P34 tests.
